401-483-3944-8125.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
401-483-3944-8125.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Davvol triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and Cruel Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat.

141-653-728.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-653-728.description:
Cast Fearsome Awakening by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Fearsome Awakening.
Holding priority, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Fearsome Awakening
Resolve the Fearsome Awakening copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

147-2438-8129.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2438-8129.notablePrerequisites: There are at least seven cards in your graveyard.
147-2438-8129.description:
Cast Stitch Together by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Stitch Together.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Stitch Together
Resolve the Stitch Together copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1379-4050-6871--183.manaNeeded: {0} plus the cost of the creature that earthbends
1379-4050-6871--183.description:
Cast the earthbending creature by paying its mana cost, causing it to enter as an artifact land creature due to Encroaching Mycosynth and Toph.
When that creature enters, it earthbends, causing itself to become a land creature with haste, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on itself, and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing that creature, adding one mana.
When that creature dies, the delayed ability from step 2 triggers, causing it to return to the battlefield tapped as an artifact land creature.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times.

1768-5231--5.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Juniper Order Ranger triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and Juniper Order Ranger.
Repeat

254-5147--5.description:
Cast First Day of Class by paying {1}{R}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, First Day of Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 2

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2511-6972-7606.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Rampant Rejuvenator.
When Rampant Rejuvenator dies, it's innate ability and persist ability each trigger.
Resolve the trigger from Rampant Rejuvenator's innate ability, allowing you to search your library for a number of basic land cards and put them onto the battlefield.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Rampant Rejuvenator from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

4222-4868-6702-7426.description:
Activate Freed from the Real's first ability by paying {U}, tapping Kilo.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate twice due to Tekuthal, thus putting two +1/+1 counters on Berta.
Berta triggers twice, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Kilo.
Repeat.

1061-5900-7393.easyPrerequisites: You control a Shard that doesn't have summoning sickness.
1061-5900-7393.description:
Activate Niko by paying {2} and tapping it, exiling Timestream Navigator and causing Shards you control to become a copy of Timestream Navigator until the end step.
Activate a Shard by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it from the battlefield onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Niko.
When Niko enters, it triggers, creating two Shard tokens.
At the beginning of the next end step, Timestream Navigator is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

4004-4089-7149.description:
Cast Glasspool Mimic by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Glasspool Mimic into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Glasspool Mimic dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Wormfang Turtle, gaining its abilities.
When Glasspool Mimic enters, its first ability triggers, exiling it.
When Glasspool Mimic leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Glasspool Mimic from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Repeat from step 2.

891-3967-4775.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Repeat.

240-4460-5470-5686.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token
Repeat from step 2.

914-3036-4460.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-3036-4460.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Wizard Mentor by paying {2}{U}.
Activate Wizard Mentor by tapping it, returning it and Dockside Extortionist to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
If opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

2919-4365-4659-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2919-4365-4659-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

5686-6528-7084.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Elfsworn Giant triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

4094-5525-5702.easyPrerequisites:
At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
4094-5525-5702.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Llanowar Loamspeaker
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 5.

136-4067-6281-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that share a creature type.
136-4067-6281-7013.description:
Activate White Lotus Tile by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Cadaver Imp.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Cadaver Imp that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Cadaver Imp token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Cadaver Imp from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping White Lotus Tile.
Repeat.

372-1090-6966.description:
Cast All-Fates Stalker by paying its mana cost.
When All-Fates Stalker enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, causing Icewind Stalwart to return to the battlefield from exile.
When Icewind Stalwart enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking All-Fates Stalker.
All-Fates Stalker leaves and enters the battlefield, triggering All-Fates Stalker's first and second abilities.
Resolve the second All-Fates Stalker trigger, returning Abdel Adrian from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the All-Fates Stalker trigger from step 5, exiling Abdel Adrian until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

3054-3416-5670-6094.easyPrerequisites:
You've gained life this turn if Oathsworn Vampire is in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
3054-3416-5670-6094.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire either from your hand or graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Edgar triggers, creating a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire.
When Oathsworn Vampire dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat steps 3 through 5 once, sacrificing the Vampire token instead.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-889-1387-1500-2871.description:
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {R}. Birgi, Blood Funnel and Deekah trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Deekah trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Blood Funnel trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature token.
Resolve the Seething Anger spell.
Repeat.

4871-5695-6019-6798.description:
Cast Infested Thrinax by paying {3}{B}{G}
When Infested Thrinax enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Saproling creature tokens when a nontoken creature you control dies.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Scourge of Nel Toth.
When Scourge of Nel Toth dies, Infested Thrinax and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Infested Thrinax trigger, creating six 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot abilities from steps 3 and 7, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Cast Scourge of Nel Toth from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} and sacrificing two Saprolings.
When the Saprolings die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

222-527-997-4927.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-997-4927.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2281-2921-5925.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Jackdaw Savior.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Jackdaw Savior.
When Jackdaw Savior dies, it and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Jackdaw Savior trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Jackdaw Savior from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

4506-5670-6291.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
4506-5670-6291.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2523-5231-5561.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Relentless Rohirrim, adding {R}.
When Relentless Rohirrim dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Relentless Rohirrim that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Relentless Rohirrim token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Relentless Rohirrim token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Repeat.

1491-2445-3755-6218.easyPrerequisites: Sinking Feeling attached to Pheres-Band Tromper.
1491-2445-3755-6218.notablePrerequisites: Pheres-Band Tromper does not have summoning sickness.
1491-2445-3755-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

1339-2498-4279.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
1339-2498-4279.description:
Activate Yawgmoth's first ability by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, causing you to draw a card and allowing you to put a -1/-1 counter on up to one creature.
The Locust God and Sheoldred's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Locust God trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Sheoldred trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

1806-3002-5231-5465.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {R}.
Eternal Scourge is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard due to Rest in Peace.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {1}.
Repeat.

1479-3534-4543.notablePrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand if Field of the Dead on the battlefield.
You control at least six lands with different names.
1479-3534-4543.description:
Play a land card from your hand.
Kodama, Trench Behemoth and Field of the Dead trigger.
If the land played was a basic land, you may activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield from your hand.
Resolve the Trench Behemoth trigger, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
Resolve the Field of the Dead trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
The Zombie enters the battlefield, triggering Kodama.
Holding priority, activate Trench Behemoth by returning a land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Trench Behemoth.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting a land onto the battlefield from your hand.
Trench Behemoth and Field of the Dead trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

1002-3352-4050-4772.description:
Cast Hooded Hydra by paying {3}{G}{G}, causing it to enter the battlefield with six +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Hooded Hydra, adding {B}.
Hooded Hydra dies, creating twelve 1/1 Snake creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar nine times by sacrificing nine Snakes, adding {7}{G}{G}.
Cast Disturbed Burial with buyback by paying {4}{B}, returning Hooded Hydra from your graveyard to your hand, and returning Disturbed Burial to your hand.
Repeat.

245-2034-4893.description:
Activate Marneus by paying {4}, creating two 2/2 Astartes Warrior creature tokens.
The tokens enter the battlefield, triggering Marneus, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing both Astartes Warriors, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

338-1178-1494.notablePrerequisites:
Light of Promise attached to Sage of Hours.
You control at least three Shrines.
338-1178-1494.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Honden of Cleansing Fire triggers, causing you to gain at least six life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting at least six +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, taking at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1812-1864-2034.description:
Cast Prossh from the command zone by paying {3}{B}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Prossh triggers, creating a 0/1 Kobolds of Kher Keep token for each mana spent to cast it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Prossh, adding {C}{C}.
Choose to return Prossh from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Kobolds of Kher Keep tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Prismite three times by paying {6}, adding {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Kobolds of Kher Keep token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 7 until you have enough mana to cast Prossh.
Repeat from step 1.

855-4929-5189.notablePrerequisites: Cryptic Trilobite has at least three +1/+1 counters.
855-4929-5189.description:
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Cryptic Trilobite, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Saproling token, putting two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Repeat.
